messages:
kevin.t: quick flag — pulled raw invoice for 2026-03-17 and it looks like committed Dedicated charges (us-west-2 GPU pool) were billed without applying the contract credits we issued last month. invoice INV-2026-03-17 shows $38,412 due. can someone confirm why credits didn't reduce that line?

maria.finance: which customer/account is this for? and can you paste the invoice snippet?

kevin.t: customer: AcornGames (acct-id: A-4127). snippet: `INV-2026-03-17 • Dedicated: $45,000 • Promo credit applied: -$6,588 • Total due: $38,412` — ledger shows contract credit CC-8891 in the account but not applied to the Dedicated line.

josh.infra: FYI reserved commitments are invoiced differently — the infra billing flow writes committed charges as "term" items and those sometimes aren't picked up by promo credits that are usage-only. I can run the ledger query if that helps.

maria.finance: please run the ledger query, kevin/josh. need the transaction ids. also @billing-bot can you dump credit metadata for A-4127?

billing-bot: automated: pulled records for acct A-4127 -> credits: ["CC-8891: contract_credit, amount:15000, status: active, expires:2026-03-23", "PROMO-2025-FALL: promo_credit, amount:6588, status: applied to invoice INV-2026-03-17"]. transactions: ["txn_98877: INV-2026-03-17: Dedicated:45000", "txn_98878: INV-2026-03-17: Promo: -6588"]. Note: CC-8891 currently has ledger tag "held_for_term".

anna.ops: oh — expires 2026-03-23 and it's Mar 17 invoice. if it's held_for_term it might require manual reclassification to apply to reserved charges. Customer verbally ok with applying to committed fees (Sophie confirmed last week).

sophie.se: confirmed — AcornGames asked us to prioritize using their contract credit to offset Dedicated tier. they sent signed confirmation on 2026-02-28. happy to attach to any manual memo.

maria.finance: okay, action plan: 1) confirm whether our billing engine blocks contract credits on "term"/reserved lines, 2) if yes, raise a manual credit memo to offset INV-2026-03-17 dedicated line, 3) update CC-8891 ledger tag to "applied" so future invoices reconcile. who's on step 1?

josh.infra: i can verify billing classification now. running: 
```
SELECT id, invoice_id, amount, classification, ledger_tag FROM ledger.transactions WHERE account_id='A-4127' AND invoice_id='INV-2026-03-17';
```

josh.infra: result -> txn_98877 classification: "term_reserved" ledger_tag: "reserved_dedicated". that will exclude promo-type reductions by default. CC-8891 has tag "contract_credit" but not linked to term_reserved flows.

maria.finance: thanks. @sophie.se can you forward the customer's signed note to billing@redwood? we need permission to do a manual credit memo (internal compliance).

sophie.se: forwarded. subject: "AcornGames - apply contract credit to Dedicated invoice". attached.pdf included.

kevin.t: is there any impact on their capacity? i.e., will we retroactively mark that invoice as paid if we do the memo, or do we need an off-invoice adjustment?

maria.finance: typically we issue a credit memo (CM) that references INV-2026-03-17, then post a journal entry to clear the outstanding balance. i'll prepare the CM once legal/ops sign off. CM format: 
```
CM-2026-03-18-A4127 • Credit memo for INV-2026-03-17 • Amount: -$15,000 (apply 100% of CC-8891 until exhausted)
```

anna.ops: note: CC-8891 expires 2026-03-23. if we don't post CM before expiration, finance policy requires escalation to revenue ops to re-issue or extend. please prioritize.

maria.finance: i'll open billing ticket with payments provider and revenue ops now. @billing-bot can you create ticket stub?

billing-bot: ticket created -> TICKET-5752: "Manual credit memo / reclass for acct A-4127 (CC-8891)" assigned to finance. deadline 2026-03-21 23:59 UTC.

sophie.se: i'll message the customer to confirm we can apply the credit immediately and share expected timing.

josh.infra: one more item — we should adjust our billing pipeline to allow contract credits tagged "contract_credit" to reduce "term_reserved" lines when customer consent exists. filing infra/billing PR after this.

kevin.t: thanks all. summary/action items: maria -> create CM + journal entry + ticket follow-up; josh -> file PR to allow credit routing for term_reserved; sophie -> confirm with customer and attach signed note to ticket; anna -> monitor CC-8891 expiry and escalate if needed. i'll follow up EOD. :thumbsup:

maria.finance: got it. opening CM now and will post updates to TICKET-5752.

kevin.t: closing thread for now, will update when CM posted.
